title: CPL Aromas celebrates an endless summer with new fragrance innovations at TFWA Cannes 2026
summary: Seaside vibes on the French Riviera, endless toasts for celebrations and the global fragrance industry coming together in Cannes: TFWA 2026 provided the perfect setting for CPL Aromas to celebrate the art of fragrance, innovation and connection

extraction.key_fact: 씨피엘 아로마스가 칸에서 열린 면세 전시회에서 새로운 향료 혁신을 선보이며 향료 예술과 연결을 기념했다.
